description: This file contains functions and regex patterns for parsing, comparing, and managing npm package release versions, including handling release channels (stable/beta), version validation, and authentication logic for publishing.

methods.name: parseDateParts
methods.description: Parses version date components and constructs a ParsedReleaseVersion object if valid.

methods.name: parseReleaseVersion
methods.description: Parses a version string into a structured release version object, handling stable, beta, and correction versions.

methods.name: compareReleaseVersions
methods.description: Compares two version strings based on date, channel, and version numbers.

methods.name: resolveNpmPublishPlan
methods.description: Determines the npm publish plan (channel, tag, mirror tags) based on version and current beta version.

methods.name: resolveNpmDistTagMirrorAuth
methods.description: Determines authentication source for npm dist tag mirroring based on provided tokens.

methods.name: shouldRequireNpmDistTagMirrorAuth
methods.description: Checks if npm dist tag mirror authentication is required based on mode, tags, and auth status.
